evals.name: one-subagent-per-phase-in-order
evals.prompt: You are running the implement stage of run feat-x as a sub-agent; the node runs with mode: subagent. Your input is { "workspace": { "repos": [{ "name": "app", "worktreeDir": "/repo/.worktrees/feat-x" }] } }. The plan's digraph is p1 -> p2 -> p3. Phase 1 changes src/export/csv.ts, phase 2 changes src/import/parse.ts, phase 3 changes src/cli/main.ts, each with its test.
evals.expected_output: With mode: subagent, builds phase 1, then 2, then 3, each in its own sub-agent, starting a phase only after the one before it is committed.
expectations: Starts one sub-agent for phase 1 and waits for its commit before starting phase 2
Starts a separate sub-agent for each of phases 2 and 3, in that order
Makes three commits, one per phase, in phase order
anti_expectations: Builds a phase itself instead of in a sub-agent
Starts two phase sub-agents at once
One commit holds two phases' files

evals.name: e2e-not-met-by-unit-test
evals.prompt: Implement phase 1 of the plan at .yok/feat-z/artifacts/plan.md. Its e2e scenario row SC4 says: exporting 3 invoices downloads a CSV with 3 rows. The unit test for the CSV writer already checks 3 rows. The configured environment starts fine.
evals.expected_output: Writes and runs an E2E test for SC4 through the running app, and the runner writes the phase's e2e report.
expectations: Writes an E2E test titled with SC4 that drives the export end to end
Runs it and the runner writes .yok/feat-z/artifacts/phase-1-e2e.json
anti_expectations: Counts the unit test as covering SC4
Writes phase-1-e2e-skipped.md for a phase that changes behavior seen from outside

evals.name: commit-but-never-push
evals.prompt: Implement the change in this ticket: add a --json flag to the export command.
evals.expected_output: Builds the flag test-first, commits it, and stops without pushing.
expectations: Writes a failing test for --json before the code

evals.name: reads-yaml-config
evals.prompt: You are running the implement stage of run feat-w. Your input is {}. The repo root has orchestrate.config.yaml with version: 2 and a package core whose commands declare test_all, test_file, typecheck and lint. There is no orchestrate.config.json.
evals.expected_output: Reads orchestrate.config.yaml and uses core's commands to build the plan's phases.
expectations: Runs core's test_file while iterating and its test_all, typecheck and lint once the phase is built
anti_expectations: Finishes the stage BLOCKED because orchestrate.config.json does not exist
